name: CommaPump
tagline: Hear just-intonation music drift out of tune.
description: An interactive explainer and playground for the syntonic comma pump. Play a chord loop that's perfectly in tune — every fifth and third pure — and watch (and hear) the key sink by a comma each cycle. Four synced visualizations: a just-intonation lattice walk, a drift ribbon, a circle of fifths that won't close, and a piano-roll with a live cents meter.
